alt: 機器人競賽失敗後整個學生隊伍坐在桌旁，賽道上的機器都停止，零件散落，老師安慰大家重新學習。
scene_prompt: A modern school robotics competition after a failed final test: an entire student team sits disappointed but safe around a worktable with every small robot stopped on the course, blank banner, and scattered parts, while a teacher offers encouragement.
